t: NixOS Recovery: Reclaiming Your System's Soul with Symlinks and Git
s: This article details a NixOS system recovery after a crash, emphasizing declarative configuration, version control with Git, and a structured approach to reintegrating old configurations using the KonMari method, focusing on stability and user control.
sub: NixOS system crash and recovery via ISO installation.
Refactoring backup scripts and application management via Flakes/Home-manager.
Prioritizing aliases, symlinks, and mounts for system stability.
